The '''Energy Emittance Baffler''' was a vital part of the [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] built as part of the [[NOVA]] project. It was made by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was destroyed or disabled by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] along with all the other components of the device.
